topics.title: Safety, Energy/Matter Fundamentals, Temperature, Pressure, and Gas Laws

subtopics.content: Workshop safety rules, PPE equipment, fire extinguishers, first aid, energy forms/conversion, internal energy, enthalpy, pressure-enthalpy (p-h) diagrams, states/changes of matter, compressor power calculations, thermometry, temperature scale conversions, pressure measurement devices (manometers, Bourdon gauges), suction/discharge pressure gauges, and gas laws (Boyle's, Charles', Dalton's, General)
subtopics.objective: Enforce safety regulations, operate fire extinguishers, and administer first aid; demonstrate mechanical to heat energy conversion and phase changes of matter; compute compressor power consumption in watts/kilowatts; convert temperature scales (Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin, Rankine) and identify fixed temperature points; measure pressure using barometers, manometers, and Bourdon gauges; solve numerical calculations using general gas laws.

topics.title: Refrigeration Cycles, Refrigerants, Air-Conditioning Processes, and Components

subtopics.content: Basic refrigeration cycle (evaporation, compression, condensation, expansion), layout diagrams, system components/accessories (relays, thermostats, solenoids, capacitors), refrigerant types/classifications/cylinder colour codes, chemical formulae, flow controls (TEV, AEV, capillary tube), psychrometric properties of air, psychrometers, sensible/latent heat, compressor types/constructions, condenser types/servicing/heat load, liquid receivers, service valves, and evaporator types/construction/servicing
subtopics.objective: Explain the vapor compression refrigeration cycle and system accessories; identify refrigerants by chemical names, formulae, properties, and cylinder color codes; operate expansion devices (TEV, AEV, capillary); measure air psychrometric properties using sling psychrometers and distinguish latent vs sensible heat; evaluate construction and working principles of compressors, condensers, and evaporators; service condensers and evaporators and compute heat load estimates.

topics.title: Workshop Practices, Installation, Insulation, and Entrepreneurship

subtopics.content: Basic RAC hand tools, window unit AC servicing, systematic fault diagnosis, leak detection, electrical continuity/polarity testing, compressor/motor/condenser/evaporator repairs, condenser/evaporator piping, ducting/trunking installation, split unit AC installation, electric motors/generators installation and maintenance, cold room principles/installation, insulating materials (glasswool, polystyrene foam, bitumen) and procedures, business enterprise types, startup funding, marketing protocols, and basic accounting records (ledgers, balance sheets)
subtopics.objective: Use basic RAC tools for cutting, reaming, flaring, and bending tubes; service window and split unit air-conditioners; execute leak testing, insulation continuity, pressure testing, and fault troubleshooting; perform piping, ducting, trunking, and motor/generator maintenance; explain cold room operations and installation procedures; select and apply thermal insulating materials correctly; formulate business plans, conduct market surveys, source capital, and prepare ledgers and balance sheets.
